name: JVM Memory Leak Debugger
description: Diagnoses JVM memory leaks from a heap dump (.hprof) and G1 GC log. Identifies the dominant object graph, root cause, GC pressure timeline, and produces ranked fix recommendations. Works with GitHub Copilot, Claude, and OpenAI Codex agent runtimes.
author: data-diff

tools.name: analyze_gc_log
tools.description: Parse a JVM G1 unified GC log file and return structured statistics: pause counts, Full GC timeline, To-space exhaustion events, live-set drift, and concurrent cycle aborts.

gc_log_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the JVM GC log file (e.g. target/jvm-logs/gc-16615.log)

returns.description: GC summary dict with config, young_gc stats, full_gc stats, full_gc_timeline, live_set_drift_mb, to_space_exhausted_count, concurrent_abort_count

tools.name: extract_heap_suspects
tools.description: Run Eclipse Memory Analyzer (MAT) headlessly on an .hprof heap dump. Auto-downloads MAT if not installed. Returns leak suspects, stack frames, dominator paths, and class histogram.

hprof_path.description: Absolute path to the .hprof heap dump file

mat_home.description: Optional path to an existing Eclipse MAT install root. If omitted, the pinned platform-specific MAT package is installed under the system temp directory.

mat_heap_gb.description: Max heap in GB for the MAT JVM process (default: 12)

timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds for MAT analysis (default: 7200)

returns.description: Dict with suspects list (suspect_number, retained_bytes, retained_pct, stack_frames, dominator_path, object_graph_classes) and histogram list

tools.name: correlate_dump_to_gc
tools.description: Correlate the heap dump file timestamp with the GC log wall-clock timeline. Classifies the dump phase (during_full_gc_storm, post_oom_recovery, normal_operation etc), computes OOM proximity percentage, and returns surrounding GC events.

gc_log_path.description: Path to the GC log file

window_s.description: Seconds around dump time to include as surrounding events (default: 60)

dump_time.description: Optional heap dump timestamp override as ISO-8601, epoch seconds, or epoch milliseconds. Used when the .hprof header timestamp is unavailable or should be overridden.

returns.description: Dict with dump_phase, dump_elapsed_s, oom_proximity_pct, live_set_at_dump_mb, inferred_trigger, surrounding_events

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Full end-to-end pipeline: parse GC log, correlate dump, extract MAT suspects, apply fix-pattern matching, and write report.json + report.md to output_dir.

hprof_path.description: Path to the .hprof heap dump file

gc_log_path.description: Path to the JVM GC log file

output_dir.description: Directory to write report.json and report.md (default: beside gc_log_path)

skip_mat.description: If true, skip running MAT (use existing suspects ZIP if present)

mat_home.description: Optional path to an existing Eclipse MAT install root. If omitted, the pinned platform-specific MAT package is installed under the system temp directory.

mat_heap_gb.description: Max heap in GB for the MAT JVM process

timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds for MAT analysis (default: 7200)

patterns_file.description: Optional path to a JSON file containing custom recommendation patterns. PATTERNS_FILE env var is also supported.

dump_time.description: Optional heap dump timestamp override as ISO-8601, epoch seconds, or epoch milliseconds.

returns.description: Dict with json_report_path, md_report_path, severity, top_recommendations

system.java17_home: Java 17+ required for Eclipse MAT. Set JAVA17_HOME or JAVA_HOME, or ensure java 17+ is available on PATH.
system.curl: Required for auto-downloading Eclipse MAT on first use.
system.mat_home: Optional path to an existing Eclipse MAT install. The tool also supports auto-installing pinned MAT ZIP distributions for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

examples.title: Full analysis
examples.description: Analyze a heap dump with GC log and generate both reports

examples.description: Parse just the GC log without running MAT
